decision.reason: The feasible weak/noisy ladder has no supported result, broad conditional regions, and a source-present median mean error that does not beat the domain-center baseline. Strong controls show that missing independent strength/background/weather information changes the result, while one extra colocated sensor does not remove the ridge.
required_information: independent local weather over the same period or multiple wind directions
spatially diverse monitors that separate competing plume geometries

ladder.interpretation: The domain-center values are an evaluator-only prior-only baseline. They are never supplied to production inference. Region area is conditional area, and ladder rows do not expose cell membership; source-region coverage is therefore reported from the v0.8 final artifact below.
